Hello boss, congrats on graduating from whatever CS is and going to empl*yment. Pray that God gives you the wisdom to NOT make questionable decisions in your career. 

Also yes everything here is engineered by AI except the verses and messages🗿
Also you should scroll down to the photos section in the bottom later to see some peak photos🗿 

Anyway jokes aside, may God bless you wherever you go in life and hope he can help you find the best j*b possible in the future. 

PS: can continue invite me for random dinner or activities (even better can invite me to ur wedding🗿)

May the Lord bless you abundantly wherever life takes you. May He guide your steps, strengthen your faith and lead you towards His wonderful plans for your life. All the best in your future endeavours! 🥳
Happy graduation!

Congratulations Andrew on graduating! You’re now on to your next chapter in life, that means no more sem breaks for the rest of your life 🫩. 

Thank you for your time and efforts in tertiary ministry these past few years. I really thank God for the conviction towards sound Biblical teaching that He has put in your heart. 

You’re never one to backdown from giving your time and energy to teaching and discipling others. I know that your service here in PKA has made a strong impression on everyone.

May Christ continue to be magnified in your life even as you move on to the workforce. 🙏!

Hii Andrew! Although we didn't interact very often, I just wanted to drop a quick note to say congrats on graduating! Praying that God grants you wisdom, grace, and joy as you transition into the working world and whatever lies ahead. All the best!

HI Andrew, Congratulations on the happiest graduation after 4 grinding years in your degree. I'm proud that you hv made all you hardwork through these challenges you faced in your degree years since you hv been seen struggling these times. Although we met each other for one year in different cell group, but you will still be remembered. May God bless you and He will give you wonderful times throughout the working journey.

HALOOOO ANDREW! YOU'RE FINALLY OLD AND DONE WITH UNI! HAHA
Anywayyy thank you for faithfully serving PKA for the past few years despite wanting to step down many times too. Thank you for showing me the importance of understanding God's word correctly and seeing the value of Gospel centred events. Now you're finally graduating, I pray that you'll continue to keep this heart for God and His people everywhere you go! 
Ps. We're waiting for your wedding announcement👀 haha

CONGRATS on Graduating Andrew! 🎉
Happy graduation! You have been here forever! You are now officially an educated person😯. May God be your strength and guide you wherever you may be!

Happy graduation! Thank you so much for being such a friendly, kind presence in our Christian community. I’ve really admired your dedication to bringing us all together and helping everyone feel connected—it has truly been a blessing to all of us.
As you step into this next chapter, I pray that God rewards your kindness, meets every single need you have for the future, and continues to guide and protect you wherever He leads you next, in Jesus’ name!
May you continue to grow in your faith and live each day in a way that pleases the Lord. May your life always be a testimony of His goodness and grace. Keep shining for Him! 🥳
Happy graduation!

HAPPY GRADUATION GIDEONNN!🎉 

First BP official batch graduating this year! Proud to be your junior :) Anywayyy thank you for serving in PKA even when you're super busy and occupied in uni. Thank you for your studies advices, truly appreciate it frfr. Thank you for listening to my random rants about lecturers and studies too. I pray that as you enter into the working world, you'll continue to stay strong in the Lord wherever you go. 

CONGRATS on Graduating Gideon!

May you glorify His name in everything you do and wherever you go. May the Lord grant you wisdom, strength and courage as you embark on this new chapter of life. All the best! 🥳
Happy graduation!

Wishing you all the very best!

I am glad to see that you're really passionate about being an English teacher to teach students from various backgrounds. I believe it was not easy to cope with it, but God will give more patience and endurance to make a wonderful class. Hope we will meet each other during graduation. May God Bless you.
